title.value: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses
title.justification: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of a debriefing tool aimed at improving non-technical skills in trauma simulation courses.
title.quote:
Objective: The study reports the use of a nominal group technique (NGT) to evaluate the PEARLS Healthcare
debriefing tool as a tool to foster non-technical skills in trauma simulation courses. Additionally, it introduces a
debriefing card to be used in trauma courses.

extractions.description: This paper discusses the evaluation and design of a debriefing tool using the PEARLS framework to enhance non-technical skills in trauma simulation courses. Utilizing a nominal group technique, the study examines the strategies' relevance and introduces a structured debriefing card.
